visual_goal: Show the legal entity register as golden source publishing to every system through an integration hub, with the three ERPs confirming their system codes back so the register holds the full mapping.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration. At the far left, a large bound register book with a gold ribbon, labeled 'Legal entity register'. One thick arrow labeled 'entity created or changed' goes right into a round hub labeled 'Integration hub'. From the hub, thin blue arrows fan out to a column of eight boxes on the right, top to bottom: 'SAP S/4HANA', 'Oracle Fusion', 'Workday Financials', 'Workday HCM', 'OneStream', 'Vertex', 'Kyriba', 'Brand platforms'. The top three boxes, 'SAP S/4HANA', 'Oracle Fusion' and 'Workday Financials', each send one curved green return arrow back across the top of the image into the register book, each carrying a small tag labeled 'code'. In total exactly twelve arrows.
alt: A legal entity register publishes entity changes through an integration hub to eight systems; SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion and Workday Financials send their system codes back to the register.

visual_goal: Show three March intercompany invoices in two currencies settling on 15 April as four net movements through a netting center with one currency conversion, with safeguarded client funds kept outside the netting.
prompt: A two-part illustration. On the left half, labeled 'Invoiced in March', four building icons: 'Stayloft Inc.' with a small dollar sign, 'Stayloft B.V.', 'Services Ireland' and 'Northmere Payments'. Three thin arrows: from 'Stayloft Inc.' to 'Stayloft B.V.' labeled 'Royalty USD 1,500,000'; from 'Stayloft Inc.' to 'Services Ireland' labeled 'USD 380,000'; from 'Stayloft B.V.' to 'Northmere Payments' labeled 'EUR 2,350,000'. On the right half, labeled '15 April netting', a round central hub labeled 'Netting center' with a euro sign, surrounded by the same four buildings. Four thick arrows: from 'Stayloft Inc.' into the hub labeled 'USD 1,880,000', with a small currency-exchange icon on it as the only conversion; from 'Stayloft B.V.' into the hub labeled 'EUR 955,947.96'; from the hub to 'Northmere Payments' labeled 'EUR 2,350,000'; from the hub to 'Services Ireland' labeled 'EUR 353,159.85'. Beside 'Northmere Payments', outside the circle of the netting, a separate locked vault labeled 'Client funds', joined to the building by a dotted line and fenced off from the hub.
alt: Three March intercompany invoices between Stayloft Inc., Stayloft B.V., Northmere Services Ireland and Northmere Payments settle on 15 April as four net movements through a euro netting center with one dollar conversion, while client funds in a locked vault stay outside the netting.

visual_goal: Show the month-end currency sequence: treasury captures one closing fixing, the rate service publishes the same rates to all ledgers and consolidation, ledgers revalue per entity, intercompany is matched at the shared rate, and translation runs once centrally.
prompt: A left-to-right flow with five stations, each with one label. At the far left, a computer screen showing a line chart, labeled 'Treasury'. One arrow into a tap-like dispenser labeled 'Rate service', with a small banner above it reading 'Working day 1'. From 'Rate service' exactly two arrows leave, each carrying the same small blank price tag: one arrow goes down-right into a single stack of three ledger books labeled 'Ledgers'; the other runs straight along the top of the image to the far right into a large box labeled 'OneStream'. Beside the 'Ledgers' stack, one circular-arrows icon with the single word 'Revalue' written next to the stack, not on the books. From 'Ledgers' one arrow goes right into two joining puzzle pieces labeled 'Intercompany matching', with a small banner above reading 'Working day 2'. From 'Intercompany matching' one arrow into 'OneStream'. From 'Ledgers' a second arrow runs along the bottom into 'OneStream', labeled 'trial balances'. Inside 'OneStream', a globe with a dollar coin and a round badge labeled 'Translate once'. In total exactly six arrows. The books and tags are blank.
alt: Treasury feeds a rate service that sends the same rate versions to the ledgers and OneStream on working day 1; ledgers revalue per entity, intercompany is matched by working day 2, and OneStream translates once centrally.

visual_goal: Show the Pillar Two dataset assembled from the entity register, pre-elimination entity results via OneStream from the three ERPs, payroll, fixed assets, tax provision and intercompany data, feeding the GloBE calculation and return.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration. A large funnel lies on its side in the center, its wide mouth facing left and its narrow spout pointing right; it is labeled 'Pillar Two dataset' and has a ribbon around it with the word 'versioned'. At the far left top, three small boxes stacked: 'SAP S/4HANA', 'Oracle Fusion' and 'Workday Financials', each with one short straight arrow into a box 'OneStream' with the small subtitle 'before eliminations'. Below them, five more source boxes stacked in a column, each holding only its label and a simple blank pictogram: 'Entity register', 'Payroll', 'Fixed assets', 'Tax provision', 'Intercompany'. One straight arrow from 'OneStream' and one straight arrow from each of the five source boxes all point into the wide left mouth of the funnel. From the narrow spout on the right, one arrow goes to a document with a globe stamp labeled 'GloBE return'. In total exactly ten arrows. The only words in the image are the quoted labels.
alt: SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion and Workday Financials feed OneStream's pre-elimination results; together with the entity register, payroll, fixed assets, tax provision and intercompany data they funnel into a versioned Pillar Two dataset that produces the GloBE return.
